ingredients.tip: Warm cold eggs in tap water for 5 minutes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a 9-inch cake pan with parchment.
Rub the citrus zest into the sugar until fragrant, then whisk in the eggs until pale.
Stream in the olive oil, whisk in yogurt, then fold in flour, baking powder, and salt.
Bake until bronzed and a tester comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Cool in the pan before turning out. Finish with olive oil and flaky salt.
